title: UTIITSL PAN Application Fees Structure
section: --- Page 1 --- PAN Application Fees at UTIITSL (w.e.f. 16th June 2018) Option 1: The Applicant requires a physical PAN Card alongwith e-PAN Card. An Applicant while submitting his/her PAN application form has to select the “Both physical PAN Card and e-PAN Card” option on the form if a physical PAN Card is required alongwith e-PAN Card. By selecting the “Both physical PAN Card and e-PAN Card” option on the PAN application form, the applicant gets: · A physical PAN Card, that shall be printed & dispatched to the communication address mentioned by the applicant in the application form. · An e-PAN Card in PDF format, at no extra fee, that shall be mailed to the e-mail id mentioned by the applicant in the application form, only if it has been provided and is valid/active. A) If the applicant submits the PAN application physically at the PAN Centres of UTIITSL : PAN Application Fees Sr. No. Dispatch particulars ( in Rs., inclusive of the applicable tax, GST@18% ) For Dispatch of physical PAN Card in India 1. 107.00 (if the communication address is an Indian address) For Dispatch of physical PAN Card outside India 2. 1017.00 (if the communication address is a foreign address) B) If the applicant applies online on the website of UTIITSL but submits the PAN application through physical mode i.e. forwards the physical documents to the PAN Centres of UTIITSL : PAN Application Fees Sr. No. Dispatch particulars ( in Rs., inclusive of the applicable tax GST@18% ) For Dispatch of physical PAN Card in India 1. 107.00 (if the communication address is an Indian address) For Dispatch of physical PAN Card outside India 2. 1017.00 (if the communication address is a foreign address) C) If the applicant applies online on the website of UTIITSL and submits the PAN application through paperless mode on the website itself i.e. using Aadhaar based e-KYC with e-Sign OR using scanned/digilocker docs with e-Sign OR using scanned/digilocker docs with Digital Signature Certificate : PAN Application Fees Sr. No. Dispatch particulars ( in Rs., inclusive of the applicable tax GST@18% ) For Dispatch of physical PAN Card in India 1. 101.00 (if the communication address is an Indian address) For Dispatch of physical PAN Card outside India 2. 1011.00 (if the communication address is a foreign address) Contd..2/-
